bio_en: Hovsep Asturian, nicknamed Topal Terter, was an Armenian Catholic who, unlike most of his community, joined the revolutionary movement. A sympathiser until the massacre of 26 September 1895, he became a fearless activist from that day on, and in summer 1896 undertook a dangerous overland mission, bringing back news of the devastated districts. Betrayed, he was arrested on board ship at Rize and sent to the Trabzon prison; already frail, he did not survive the effects of prison and winter transport on Turkish steamers, and Droshak mourned him in August 1899.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. Year of death not stated (before Aug 1899).
